string.name: passcode_length_hint
string.value: Longer passcodes are harder to guess.

string.name: device_fingerprint_hint
string.value: Your other devices show this in a pairing request from this one. Check it matches before accepting.

string.name: dialog_save_image_prompt
string.value: Save this image to your gallery?

string.name: dialog_clear_passcode_message
string.value: New devices won't trust this device automatically any more. Devices already paired stay paired.

string.name: dialog_clear_history_message
string.value: Removes every synced item and any files saved for them from this device. Paired devices keep their own copies, but won't send these back.

string.name: dialog_delete_item_message
string.value: Removes it, and any file saved for it, from this device. Paired devices keep their own copies, but won't send this one back.

string.name: pairing_request_named
string.value: "%1$s" wants to pair with this device.

string.name: pairing_request_unnamed
string.value: A device wants to pair with this device.

string.name: pairing_request_warning
string.value: Only accept if you expect this - your Pairing screen being open is what let this request reach you at all.

string.name: toast_pairing_cancelled
string.value: The other device cancelled the pairing request - try again.

string.name: toast_passcode_set
string.value: Passcode set — matching devices will auto-trust.

string.name: toast_pairing_info_copied
string.value: Pairing info copied — paste it into Windows' Trust a Device dialog.

string.name: toast_paste_not_granted
string.value: Tap did not grant access — try again.

string.name: toast_file_store_not_ready_yet
string.value: File store not ready yet — try again.

string.name: toast_file_store_not_ready
string.value: File store not ready — try again.

string.name: toast_paste_save_failed
string.value: Could not save the file — try again.

string.name: toast_paste_sync_failed
string.value: Could not sync that — try again.

string.name: toast_self_test_passed
string.value: Self-test passed — identity, signing, and trust store all working.

string.name: toast_not_a_file
string.value: That item is not a file.

string.name: toast_no_app_to_open
string.value: No app on this device can open %1$s.

string.name: refuse_too_large
string.value: That file is over 1 GB — too large to sync.

string.name: refuse_folder
string.value: Only files can be synced, not folders.

string.name: scan_no_address
string.value: %1$s has no address in its code - if it's on the same network, just keep this screen open and its beacon will trigger pairing automatically.

string.name: outcome_prompt
string.value: Reached %1$s - accept the pairing prompt on both devices to finish.

string.name: outcome_awaiting_other
string.value: Reached %1$s - accept the request on that device to finish.

string.name: outcome_busy
string.value: Another pairing request is already waiting here - accept or reject it first.

string.name: outcome_refused
string.value: %1$s answered but didn't accept this device. Set the same passcode on both, or open its Pairing screen (and finish any other pairing request there), then try again.

string.name: outcome_silent
string.value: %1$s accepted the connection but ClipLink there didn't respond - try restarting it on that device.

string.name: outcome_unreachable
string.value: Couldn't connect to %1$s. Check ClipLink is running there and both devices are on Tailscale (or the same network).

string.name: synced_empty_detail
string.value: Copy something on this or another trusted device and it will appear here.

string.name: devices_empty
string.value: Trusted devices, and nearby devices on the same network, will show up here.

string.name: me_auto_copy_subtitle
string.value: Puts whatever arrives straight onto this device's clipboard.

string.name: me_notice_subtitle
string.value: HarmonyOS only lets ClipLink read the clipboard when you tap Paste, so this highlights Paste when you've copied something new, including while ClipLink was closed.

string.name: me_bottom_glow_subtitle
string.value: A soft wash of your theme colour along the bottom of each page.

string.name: pairing_open_detail
string.value: A pairing request only reaches this device while this screen is open, and only completes once you tap Accept here - keep it open on BOTH devices at the same time while pairing. Leaving this screen closes the window; nothing pairs silently in the background.

string.name: pairing_scan_hint
string.value: Scan this on another device (with its own Pairing screen open) to find it.

string.name: pairing_by_address_hint
string.value: No camera on the other device (e.g. Windows)? Type or paste its address - or its pairing text copied below - here instead.

string.name: pairing_info_hint
string.value: Copy this and send it to the other device (e.g. paste it into ITS Pair by Address field above) so it knows where to find this one.

string.name: passcode_intro
string.value: Devices entering the same passcode trust each other automatically.

string.name: passcode_is_set
string.value: Passcode is set on this device.

string.name: network_intro
string.value: HarmonyOS can't detect this automatically - copy your tailnet IP from the Tailscale app and paste it here so other devices can reach this one off your local network.

string.name: devicename_intro
string.value: Other devices show this name instead of this device's ID. Leave it empty to use the name from system settings.
